title: Towers embed into levelwise injective split towers
statement: For every inverse system [def-weil-inverse-system] A=(A_n,f_n)_{n\geq1} of abelian groups [def-sp-abelian], there is a monomorphism A\to I in the abelian category of towers [lem-pc-tower-abelian] such that every I_n is an injective abelian group [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and every transition map I_{n+1}\to I_n is a split surjection.

proof.text: Use the Mathlib enough-injectives presentation at every level to define J n and j n.

Recursively define I 0 = J 0 and I (n+1) = I n × J (n+1), with first projections as transitions and product lifts for the embedding components. Package these maps using Functor.ofOpSequence and NatTrans.ofOpSequence.

Each component is mono because its second coordinate is the injective envelope inclusion; NatTrans.mono_of_mono_app gives Mono i. Inductively products of injective objects are injective, and each first projection is split epi by the standard product section.

split_report.summary: Expanded the omitted Tag 07KW footnote construction. Choose injective envelopes J_n levelwise using the existing module-enough-injectives theorem specialized to Z-modules, recursively set I_{n+1}=I_n\oplus J_{n+1} with projection transitions, and verify levelwise injectivity gives a monomorphism of towers.
